caveat: Research topics are derived from the current local wiki candidate; they are hypotheses/questions for future work, not accepted claims.
policy: derived from local wiki only; no invented evidence/claim/cite/DOI/product bindings

topics.title: Does claim 2929's attached evidence actually bear on internal AGN feedback?
topics.q: Can the 14 non-committal evidence rows on claim 2929 be adjudicated into a supporting, refuting, or genuinely-neutral stance for internal AGN feedback regulating/quenching star formation?
topics.why: On the M1 wiki, 2929 is trust=unverified with 14 rows that are ALL non-committal (0 support / 0 refute), and 6 of its 8 distinct papers appear only as unresolved arXiv identifiers.
topics.basis: M1 evidence card 'Claim 2929' (unverified) + the 2929 caution box; coverage map bound.2929.
topics.limits: Non-committal + unresolved-title rows may simply be off-topic; adjudication must not manufacture a stance the papers do not take.
topics.next: Resolve the 6 bare-arXiv titles from the local ledger, re-read each abstract, and re-tag stance — docs-only, no new external search.

topics.title: Under what selection does internal vs environmental quenching separate? (claim 2931)
topics.q: For which sample selections, redshifts, and quenching definitions do the internal (mass-linked) and environmental channels become separable, given the split evidence?
topics.why: 2931 is trust=debated with a minority supporting (4 rows) against a large non-committal set (16 rows) across 13 distinct papers (2024-2026).
topics.basis: M1 evidence card 'Claim 2931' (debated); its 4-support/16-none stance split.
topics.limits: 'Debated' reflects a real split; a single reconciling answer may not exist — frame as a conditions-map, not a verdict.
topics.next: Group the 4 supporting vs 16 non-committal papers by selection/redshift/measure and map where they agree/disagree — docs-only.

topics.title: Is sustained AGN maintenance heating observed, or only simulated? (claim 2946)
topics.q: Is there observational (non-simulation) evidence for sustained AGN heating as a maintenance mechanism in massive systems, beyond the model/simulation support currently backing the claim?
topics.why: 2946 is trust=reported: all 9 supporting rows are simulation/model studies (IllustrisTNG, HORIZON-AGN, etc.), so support is model-dependent, not a measured prevalence.
topics.basis: M1 evidence card 'Claim 2946' (reported); its all-simulation supporting set.
topics.limits: Absence of observational rows here is a local-ledger gap, not proof none exists; state as an open question.
topics.next: Audit the local ledger for any observational maintenance-mode evidence attachable to 2946 — docs-only.

topics.title: Which of the 27 unbound claims are most tractable to evidence first?
topics.q: Of the 27 claims marked 'no local evidence / unbound', which are highest-value and most tractable to bind to evidence, and in what order?
topics.why: Only 3 of 30 claims carry local evidence; 27 are unbound-local — real claims with no evidence rows, explicitly not high-trust.
topics.basis: M1 'no local evidence / unbound' section (27 pills) + coverage map unbound_local.
topics.limits: Prioritization is a planning judgement, not a trust claim; binding itself needs the product claim/evidence layer (a closed gate).
topics.next: Rank the 27 by section importance + expected evidence availability into a docs-only backlog.

topics.title: What would move the 7 evidence-empty sections beyond narrative-only?
topics.q: For the 7 of 9 sections with zero evidence-linked claims, what specific evidence would raise them from narrative-only to evidence-backed?
topics.why: The per-section trust rollup shows only 2 of 9 sections (Overview; AGN Feedback & Quenching) contain any evidence-linked claim; the other 7 are entirely unbound-local.
topics.basis: M1 'Trust coverage by section' table (2 of 9 evidenced).
topics.limits: Section coverage reflects current local data only; a bare section is a data gap, not a weak-science verdict.
topics.next: Per empty section, list the one or two claims whose evidence would most improve coverage — docs-only gap audit.

topics.title: How much does unresolved-title / malformed-link data quality distort the trust picture?
topics.q: If the bare-arXiv-ID rows were resolved and the malformed links corrected, would any bound claim's trust level change?
topics.why: Across the 3 bound claims many distinct papers are unresolved arXiv IDs, and 2 evidence URLs were malformed (double-prefix) and had to be normalized.
topics.basis: M1 evidence tables' 'unresolved title' / 'link id normalized' flags + the v2.1 review/patch note.
topics.limits: Resolution is metadata cleanup, not new evidence; it may or may not shift a stance.
topics.next: Resolve titles/metadata for the flagged rows from the local ledger and re-check whether stance counts move — docs-only.

topics.title: Rows vs distinct papers: does deduplication change any trust level?
topics.q: When the 43 evidence rows are collapsed to their 26 distinct papers, does the independent-source count alter any claim's debated/unverified/reported label?
topics.why: The wiki stresses rows can repeat a paper (43 rows -> 26 distinct papers) and that distinct papers, not rows, are the honest measure of support.
topics.basis: M1 'How to read the evidence counts' explainer + per-card 'N rows / M papers' counts.
topics.limits: A recount is arithmetic on existing data; it changes interpretation, not evidence.
topics.next: Recompute per-claim stance on a distinct-paper basis and compare to the row-basis labels — docs-only.

topics.basis: M1 per-section rollup (AGN Feedback & Quenching evidenced) + cards for 2929/2946.
topics.limits: Acceptance criteria are a methodology proposal, not a promotion of the claims themselves.
